title: SAP Sales Returns and Claims Architecture Notes

semantic_keys.name: returns_order_reason
semantic_keys.meaning: Why the return transaction exists at header/commercial level

semantic_keys.name: return_reason
semantic_keys.meaning: Why the customer returns the item; customer-facing root-cause dimension

semantic_keys.name: inspection_code
semantic_keys.meaning: What was physically found during inspection

semantic_keys.name: logistical_follow_up
semantic_keys.meaning: What physically happens next to the returned quantity

semantic_keys.name: refund_type
semantic_keys.meaning: What the customer receives: credit or replacement

semantic_keys.name: refund_control
semantic_keys.meaning: When/how compensation is executed: defer, approved flow, immediate or none

semantic_keys.name: refund_code
semantic_keys.meaning: Commercial extent of the refund, typically a percentage

architecture_traps.rule: Do not equate goods receipt with ownership; deferred returns can enter non-valuated returns stock first.
Refund can trigger ownership/valuation; decide whether valuation should instead wait for final logistical follow-up.
For credit/debit memo request approval workflow, do not also configure a billing block on the relevant request type if workflow is expected to start; choose governance deliberately.
Keep customer reason, inspection result, physical disposition and refund decision as separate dimensions.
Choose Customer Return V2/V4/A2A by required features; do not assume parity.
Separate business capability from app/release support for repair follow-up.
Treat configurable-material returns as a separate edge because some free-stock and Service follow-ups have restrictions.

valuation_choices.question: Is current material valuation the correct economic basis?
Should valuation use historical sales context where supported/configured?
Is refund really the ownership trigger, or should final disposition transfer ownership?

ewm_modes.sequence: returns order → S/4 inspection/decision → follow-on document → EWM execution
returns order → EWM goods receipt/inspection → local simple follow-up or hand complex decision back to S/4

api_choices.watch: feature set differs from V2; approval release/reject differs

api_choices.watch: new capabilities are concentrated in V4

api_choices.fit: external inspection applications and inspection split items
api_choices.watch: inspection interface, not full returns orchestration

deployment_edges.rule: Treat A (after receipt of credit memo) as deployment/process specific, not universal across current Public Cloud descriptions.
Older/deployment-specific ARM can expose repair activities beyond 0026; verify release and target Service architecture.
Verify 0002/0011 and Service-repair restrictions before reusing generic ARM design for configurable returns.
